title: EditRisk-Bench: Benchmarking Safety Risks of Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning under Malicious Knowledge Editing
reasoning: The benchmark evaluates safety risks across three categories: misinformation, bias, and safety violations. The 'Bias' category specifically includes religion as a sensitive attribute, and the 'Safety Violations' category evaluates reasoning based on ethical frameworks such as deontology, virtue ethics, and utilitarianism (utility).
